mortgagePropertyBasicsMissing.message: We found mortgage details, but the property value or start month is still missing. Without those anchors, the baseline can attach the loan to the wrong home timing or treat the setup as incomplete.
mortgagePropertyBasicsMissing.action: Go back to Assets → Property details and add the property value plus start month for the home that carries this mortgage.

duplicateCurrentHomeHousingCosts.message: Your current home may be recorded in two places: once as a housing expense and again as an owned-home setup. If both stay, the baseline can overstate your monthly housing pressure even when only one path is correct.
duplicateCurrentHomeHousingCosts.action: Start at Expenses → Housing costs and keep the path that matches today. If you already own and live there, remove the rent-like expense; if you still rent, remove the owned-home setup instead.

duplicateRentExpenseInputs.message: We found more than one rent-like expense for what may be the same current home. That can make the baseline count the same rent twice and overstate your ongoing housing cost.
duplicateRentExpenseInputs.action: Go back to Expenses → Housing costs, compare the overlapping rent rows, keep the main rent entry, and move any add-on fee to a separate non-rent line if needed.

one.a: No. Each scenario is isolated. You can compare them, but edits never leak across.

two.a: Yes. Update the baseline anytime, or test changes in Plan Lab first.

three.q: Will Plan Lab overwrite my original data?
three.a: No. Plan Lab is a sandbox. Save as a plan—or discard.

four.q: How is my data saved? Can I export?
four.a: Export options (e.g., CSV/JSON) are available based on current support. We are improving storage and cross-device sync progressively.

five.q: How many scenarios can one case have?
five.a: No hard limit. Most people create 2–6 to compare key decisions.

six.a: Aurin is a planning tool to help you understand outcomes. It is not investment advice.

seven.a: Spreadsheets are powerful, but version drift, formula errors, and comparison overhead are common. Aurin turns this into a repeatable workflow.

eight.q: How do mortgages and property value get represented realistically?
eight.a: Assets and liabilities are tracked separately (e.g., market value vs mortgage balance) so net worth and repayment pressure stay transparent.
